stem.text: The density of water is $1.0\,\text{g cm}^{-3}$ and the density of glycerine is $1.3\,\text{g cm}^{-3}$.

Water is added to a measuring cylinder containing $40\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of glycerine so that the density of the mixture is $1.1\,\text{g cm}^{-3}$. Assume that the mixing process does not change the total volume of the liquid.
What is the volume of water added?
